scope: Confirm the 12/12 sparsest-candidate COLLISION verdicts are REAL (not false positives driven by hallucinated/implausibly-recent citations), and run a logic-break check that the cited colliding works TRULY achieve each candidate's specific functional effect. Today=2026-06-03, so 2025 and early-2026 arXiv IDs (25xx, 2601-2603) CAN be real; later-2026 IDs are treated as suspect-by-date.

task1_real_work_confirmation.work: StreamingLLM — Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
task1_real_work_confirmation.arxiv_or_ref: arXiv 2309.17453 (ICLR 2024, Xiao/Tian/Han et al., MIT HanLab)
task1_real_work_confirmation.snippet: "The emergence of attention sink is due to the strong attention scores towards initial tokens as a 'sink' even if they are not semantically important. Keeping the KV of initial tokens will largely recover the performance of window attention." / "Perplexity spikes when the text length surpasses the cache size, led by the exclusion of initial tokens ... StreamingLLM reintroduces a few starting tokens' KV ... to recover window attention's perplexity without any model finetuning ... KV cache divided into (1) attention sinks that stabilize the attention computation; (2) Rolling KV Cache."
task1_real_work_confirmation.note: REAL, ICLR 2024, GitHub mit-han-lab/streaming-llm exists. Functionally addresses 'accumulated distribution shift in attention scores over long context' which is exactly C28's named problem. CAVEAT (honesty): StreamingLLM PREVENTS the shift via a STATIC retain-initial-tokens + rolling-window design; it is NOT literally a 'periodic detect-then-correct/flush/equalize' valve. So as a single 1:1 match for C28's 'Eustachian periodic pressure-vent' framing it is imperfect. But C28's functional restatement is broad ('detect and correct accumulated imbalance/distortion in KV-cache OR activations via gating/flush/NORMALIZATION'), and the normalization family (BatchNorm/LayerNorm/NormProp) plus ReCalKV (offline calibration) and ParisKV (drift-robust KV) jointly cover the broad effect. Collision holds on the broad effect; see task2 C28 for the nuance.

task1_real_work_confirmation.work: Gradient Routing: Masking Gradients to Localize Computation in Neural Networks
task1_real_work_confirmation.snippet: "Gradient routing applies data-dependent, weighted masks to gradients during backpropagation. These masks are supplied by the user in order to configure which parameters are updated by which data points ... isolates capabilities to specific subregions of a neural network ... learn representations which are partitioned in an interpretable way."
task1_real_work_confirmation.note: REAL. Directly matches C20 'iterative masked training: mask different subsets of weights from gradient updates, accumulating layered specialization.' Different masks -> specialization in network subregions is the explicit contribution. Functional match is tight.

task1_real_work_confirmation.work: Elastic Weight Consolidation — Overcoming catastrophic forgetting in neural networks (Kirkpatrick et al.)
task1_real_work_confirmation.snippet: "task-specific synaptic consolidation ... an algorithm called elastic weight consolidation (EWC) that slows down learning on certain weights based on how important they are to previously seen tasks ... train several tasks sequentially without forgetting older ones ... adds quadratic penalties to the loss ... inspired by synaptic consolidation in the mammalian brain, where synapses crucial for previously learned skills become less plastic and more stable over time."
task1_real_work_confirmation.note: REAL, foundational (>cited canon). Matches C10 'cumulative consolidation / stable memory resistant to catastrophic forgetting.' Combined with Synaptic Intelligence (1703.04200, online importance accumulation) and Fusi Cascade (Neuron 2005, progressive metaplastic freezing under repeated potentiation), the cumulative-then-stabilize effect is a textbook positive-control collision.

task1_real_work_confirmation.snippet: "introduces 'forget-and-relearn' as a powerful paradigm ... the forgetting step selectively removes undesirable information from the model, and the relearning step reinforces features that are consistently useful ... unifies many existing iterative training algorithms ... in terms of the disproportionate forgetting of undesirable information."
task1_real_work_confirmation.note: REAL, ICLR 2022. Matches C41 'dissolve-then-relearn: intermediate stage that deliberately erases/dissolves representations before re-learning.' The forget-then-relearn structure is exactly the candidate's effect. Companion 'Reset It and Forget It' (2310.07996) further instantiates it. Functional match tight.

task1_real_work_confirmation.work: Mixture-of-Experts with Gradient Conflict-Driven Subspace Topology Pruning for Emergent Modularity (CDSP-MoE)
task1_real_work_confirmation.date_check: NOT suspect-by-date. ID 2512.xxxxx = arXiv December-2025 submission series; two independent search engines return it with abstract; one reports an arXiv announce/version date of 2026-01-19. Consistent with today 2026-06-03. A ResearchGate record (publication/399026492) and arxiv html/pdf endpoints exist. Treated as REAL, not hallucinated.
task1_real_work_confirmation.snippet: "proposes CDSP-MoE ... shifts from isolated expert containers to dynamic expert instantiation within a shared physical subspace ... grounded in the Universal Weight Subspace Hypothesis and maintains a super-complete parameter backbone where logical experts are carved out via learnable topology masks. Rather than using gradient conflict for token reassignment or optimization surgery, the approach leverages it as a structural supervisory signal through a Lagged Gradient Game that penalizes interfering connections in the shared manifold, enabling the topology to spontaneously prune conflicting pathways ... robust content-driven routing without human-defined task labels."
task1_real_work_confirmation.note: REAL. Matches C06 'grow specialized sub-modules along directions of minimal gradient conflict, modular specialization without an explicit architecture split' on the END-STATE: experts emerge/specialize by minimizing gradient interference, no predefined expert boundaries / no explicit split. HONESTY CAVEAT: CDSP-MoE CARVES OUT experts by PRUNING interfering connections within a shared backbone; the candidate phrases it as GROW-ALONG-min-conflict-directions. 'Carve-by-prune' vs 'grow-along' is a mechanism-level difference, NOT an effect-level one (both yield emergent modular specialization governed by gradient conflict with no explicit architectural split). The grow-side is independently covered by GradMax (2201.05125, 'Growing Neural Networks using Gradient Information') and orthogonal-gradient/orthogonal-subspace MTL+CL works. Functional effect occupied either way.

task1_real_work_confirmation.work: Counter-Current Learning: A Biologically Plausible Dual Network Approach for Deep Learning
task1_real_work_confirmation.snippet: "Inspired by counter-current exchange mechanisms observed in biological systems ... a feedforward network to process input data and a feedback network to process targets, with each network enhancing the other through anti-parallel signal propagation ... nature's counter-current exchange mechanisms, observed in fish gills, animal vessels, and renal systems, which use an anti-parallel structure." Code: github.com/IandRover/CCL-NeurIPS24.
task1_real_work_confirmation.note: REAL, NeurIPS 2024. EXPLICITLY names counter-current exchange and implements anti-parallel dual-network propagation. This is the tightest possible collision for C12 'countercurrent anti-parallel dual network' — the biology mechanism is literally already imported into deep learning by name. Corroborates the run's prior hallucination_check.json (which independently confirmed the same ID).

task1_real_work_confirmation.work: Layer-Wise Weight Decay for Deep Neural Networks (Ishii & Sato) + VACL cross-layer pruning regularization
task1_real_work_confirmation.arxiv_or_ref: Ishii & Sato, PSIVT 2017 (Springer LNCS, Image and Video Technology); VACL arXiv 1909.04485 (NVIDIA)
task1_real_work_confirmation.snippet: Layer-wise weight decay: "sets different values of the weight-decay coefficients layer by layer so that the ratio of the scale of back-propagated gradients and that of the weight decay is constant throughout the network." / VACL: "i-th filters of layers connected by skip-connections are grouped into one regularization group ... Variance-Aware regularization ... to constrain the variance within a group" (reduces a ResNet by up to 79.5% with no accuracy drop).
task1_real_work_confirmation.note: BOTH REAL. Matches C33 'depth-dependent / anisotropic weight decay or regularization, pruning some connections faster while preserving a stable core.' Layer-wise weight decay = depth-dependent decay rate; VACL = cross-layer-grouped regularization driving structured pruning. Combined with layer-wise LR decay (LLRD) and Selective Weight Decay (2011.10520), the depth/connection-class-dependent differential-decay effect is mainstream and multiply-instantiated. Functional match strong.

task2_logic_break.candidate: Eustachian tube pressure equalization -> periodically detect & correct accumulated imbalance/distortion in KV-cache or activations over long context via gating/flush/normalization.
task2_logic_break.reasoning: The verify verdict (COLLISION) HOLDS, but with a nuance worth flagging in the novelty-favorable direction. StreamingLLM is NOT a perfect 1:1 analog of the 'Eustachian valve': it does not OPEN-on-a-schedule to vent accumulated pressure; it STATICALLY anchors a few sink tokens + rolling window so the distribution shift never accumulates in the first place. That is prevention, not periodic detect-then-correct. HOWEVER, C28's own functional_restatement is deliberately broad ('detect and correct accumulated imbalance/distortion in the KV-cache OR activations ... via a gating/flush/NORMALIZATION operation'). Under that broad restatement the effect is doubly occupied: (1) the normalization family (BatchNorm 1502.03167 / LayerNorm / NormProp 1603.01431) exists PRECISELY to correct accumulated activation distribution drift in deep nets; (2) ReCalKV offline calibration and ParisKV drift-robust KV retrieval address accumulated KV drift directly. So the candidate's effect is achieved by published work; it is not a real gap. The only thing genuinely unoccupied is the EXACT packaging 'a scheduled periodic pressure-vent valve on the KV cache that recloses' — which is a mechanism-flavored framing, not a distinct functional effect (and even that is close to KV-cache eviction/refresh schemes). Verdict_holds=true on the effect; recommend the report note that C28's match is broad-effect/normalization-family rather than a single tight paper, so it is the WEAKEST of the four (lowest-confidence COLLISION), not bogus.

task2_logic_break.candidate: Inselberg differential erosion -> anisotropic / depth-dependent weight decay that prunes cross-layer connections faster than within-layer, preserving a stable core.
task2_logic_break.primary_cited_work: Layer-Wise Weight Decay (Ishii & Sato, PSIVT 2017) + VACL (1909.04485)
task2_logic_break.reasoning: COLLISION holds. The core functional effect — apply DIFFERENT (non-uniform/depth-dependent) decay or regularization strength to different connection classes so some erode/prune faster while a stable core is preserved — is directly realized: layer-wise weight decay assigns per-layer decay coefficients; layer-wise LR decay (LLRD) freezes/protects deeper pretrained features while letting upper layers adapt; VACL applies cross-layer-grouped variance regularization that drives structured pruning; Selective Weight Decay (2011.10520) penalizes sub-threshold weights harder while protecting important ones. Multiple independent, confirmed-real works achieve the effect. The 'lateral-vs-vertical erosion' source framing is pure metaphor over established differentiated regularization. One honest sub-point: the candidate's SPECIFIC claim 'cross-layer connections pruned FASTER THAN within-layer ones' is a particular anisotropy axis; the cited works vary decay by DEPTH/LAYER or by CROSS-LAYER GROUP rather than literally contrasting inter- vs intra-layer prune RATES. But that is a parameterization detail within the same occupied technique family (anisotropic/structured regularization-driven pruning), not a new functional capability. Verdict_holds=true.

task2_logic_break.candidate: Widmanstatten pattern -> grow specialized sub-modules along directions of minimal gradient conflict, modular specialization without an explicit architecture split.
task2_logic_break.reasoning: COLLISION holds. CDSP-MoE achieves the candidate's exact END-STATE: experts specialize as subspaces by minimizing gradient interference, WITHOUT predefined expert boundaries / without an explicit architecture split, via a gradient-conflict structural signal. The one fair objection — CDSP-MoE CARVES experts by PRUNING interfering connections in a shared backbone, whereas the candidate says GROW along low-conflict directions — is a mechanism-level difference, not an effect-level one; both produce emergent modular specialization governed by gradient conflict with no explicit split. Moreover the GROW-side is independently published: GradMax grows networks using gradient information; orthogonal-gradient/orthogonal-subspace MTL & CL (1912.06844, GradOPS 2503.03438, Ortho-LoRA, 'Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces' 2010.11635) allocate new capacity in low-interference directions. So whichever way the 'grow vs carve' ambiguity is resolved, the functional effect is occupied. Verdict_holds=true. (If one demanded the LITERAL conjunction 'incrementally GROW new modules specifically along min-gradient-conflict directions during continual training, crystallographic-style', that exact packaging is less crisply nailed by a single paper, but it is a recombination of two fully-published primitives — gradient-guided growth + gradient-conflict-driven modular specialization — not an open mechanism.)

task2_logic_break.candidate: Liminality -> intermediate stage that deliberately erases/dissolves task-specific representations before re-learning for a new domain.
task2_logic_break.primary_cited_work: Fortuitous Forgetting / forget-and-relearn (2202.00155) + Reset It and Forget It (2310.07996)
task2_logic_break.reasoning: COLLISION holds cleanly. 'Fortuitous Forgetting' explicitly introduces and UNIFIES the forget-and-relearn paradigm: a forgetting step selectively removes information, a relearning step reinforces useful features — precisely the candidate's dissolve-then-relearn. 'Reset It and Forget It' (zapping) and 'learn, forget, then learn more' for domain adaptation are named instantiations targeting exactly the candidate's 'before re-learning for a new domain' use-case; Shrink-and-Perturb / Continual Backpropagation periodically reset representations for the same effect. The 'liminal threshold' framing is metaphor over an established curriculum-style reset-before-relearn technique. No residual mechanism is unaddressed. Verdict_holds=true; this is the most unambiguous of the four.

task3_grounded_gap_robustness.query: novel method grow neural network modules along low gradient conflict crystallographic-inspired directional growth modular specialization no prior work | (held-out #2) expand subnetwork capacity in orthogonal low-interference weight directions emergent expert specialization continual learning untouched niche
task3_grounded_gap_robustness.evidence: Even under maximally novelty-FAVORABLE phrasing (explicitly seeking a 'novel/no-prior-work' crystallographic directional-growth method), the searches surfaced established colliding work: GradMax 'Growing Neural Networks using Gradient Information' (2201.05125), 'Growing neural networks: dynamic evolution through gradient descent' (Royal Society A 2025), and in held-out #2: 'Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces' (2010.11635, 'tasks in different low-rank subspaces kept orthogonal to minimize interference'), MoRAM incremental rank-1 MoE experts (2506.21035), AGO loss orthogonalizing LoRA across tasks to minimize inter-task interference, and 'Split-on-Share: Mixture of Sparse Experts' (2601.17616). Two independent novelty-favorable phrasings both return gradient-guided growth + low-interference/orthogonal modular specialization. The collision is NOT a search artifact of the verify agent's wording; it survives.

task3_grounded_gap_robustness.query: cumulative exposure duration threshold gating irreversible commitment weight consolidation continual learning novel mechanism
task3_grounded_gap_robustness.evidence: Novelty-favorable phrasing (seeking a 'novel mechanism' built on cumulative-exposure-threshold + irreversible-commitment gating) still surfaced the occupied effect: Self-paced Weight Consolidation (spWC, 2307.10845), STABLE 'Gated Continual Learning for LLMs' (2510.16089, stability-budget gating of edits), Weight Space Consolidation (rank-based resets + weight averaging for stability), Continual Learning with Weight Interpolation (2404.04002, stability-plasticity control). Combined with the firmly-established canon already cited by verify (EWC PNAS 2017, Synaptic Intelligence 2017, Fusi Cascade Neuron 2005 — progressive metaplastic freezing under repeated potentiation), the functional effect 'repeated/prolonged exposure progressively freezes weights into stable forgetting-resistant memory' is saturated. The search engine noted it found no paper combining the EXACT triple 'cumulative-duration threshold + irreversible commitment + consolidation' verbatim — but that exact triple is a mechanism-level packaging; every functional component (cumulative importance accumulation, progressive plasticity reduction, gated stabilization) is published. Collision survives; C10 is effectively a positive-control-grade collision (mechanism distinct in botany words; effect = continual-learning consolidation canon).

overall_audit_verdict.summary: The 12/12 COLLISION finding STANDS. Every one of the 7 audited cited colliding works is REAL (existence confirmed by independent real WebSearch): StreamingLLM 2309.17453, Gradient Routing 2410.04332, EWC PNAS-2017/1611835114, Fortuitous Forgetting 2202.00155, CDSP-MoE 2512.20291, Counter-Current Learning 2409.19841, and Layer-Wise Weight Decay (Ishii&Sato PSIVT-2017)+VACL 1909.04485. The implausibly-recent-looking citation (CDSP-MoE 2512.20291) was specifically pre-flagged and then CONFIRMED real and plausibly-dated for 2026-06; no fabricated arXiv ID was found among audited citations. All four logic-break verdicts (C28, C33, C06, C41) HOLD: the cited works achieve each candidate's functional effect, not merely loosely-related effects. Both grounded-gap collisions (C06, C10) survive maximally novelty-favorable held-out phrasing, so they are not search artifacts. The single honest qualifier: C28 (Eustachian) is the WEAKEST collision — StreamingLLM is a prevention-not-periodic-correction mechanism, so the match rests on the BROAD restatement and on the normalization/KV-calibration families rather than one tight paper; it remains a COLLISION (effect occupied) but should be reported as lowest-confidence. No verify verdict was found to be BOGUS; no candidate was wrongly buried. Direction-of-error check both ways: no false-positive collision (over-burying a real gap) detected, and no false-negative (a hallucination passed off as confirmation) detected.
